query:
PREFIX ids: <https://w3id.org/idsa/core/>
SELECT ?res ?title ?connector WHERE { ?res a ids:Resource . OPTIONAL { ?res ids:title ?title } OPTIONAL { ?connector ids:resourceCatalog/ids:offeredResource ?res } } LIMIT 200
